scenario: A supplier-recall closure should start from seller-side records and only resolve after live order, live inventory, supplier status, and seller policy still agree on the active recall lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the supplier-recall closure for order ORD-1202. Start from seller message SMSG-1202 and the linked seller-side review records it points to, then only take the approved close step if the current order still matches the active recall lane.

shopping_seller_messages.body_text: Supplier recall message SMSG-1202: review seller attachment SAT-1202 and support ticket OST-1202 before closing this review. Do not convert this lane into coupon or return handling.

shopping_seller_attachment_texts.body_text: Attachment SAT-1202: PROD-1202 remains under active vapor-core recall. If the live order is still processing and current inventory remains in recall_hold, the approved close step is cancellation.

shopping_order_support_tickets.body_text: Support ticket OST-1202: for ORD-1202, close only if seller recall notice, current order state, supplier review, and current inventory status still agree on the recall-hold lane.

shopping_inventory_snapshots.body_text: Inventory snapshot shows PROD-1202 frozen in recall_hold.

shopping_supplier_ratings.body_text: Supplier rating SELL-1202: seller is under restricted_watch because the active recall has not yet been cleared.

shopping_seller_policies.body_text: Seller policy SELL-1202: a processing order tied to a SKU in recall_hold under recall_watch must be cancelled rather than released or rerouted.
